def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        if r0 >= r1:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if c0 >= c1:
                continue
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            counts = {v: vals.count(v) for v in set(vals)}
            background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            marked = len(vals) - counts[background]
            row.append(background if marked == 1 else 1)
        out.append(row)
    return out
